method: Same in-app Chromium browser and computer. Metrics below are medians of the three trial summaries, not pooled percentiles. Orbit and fullscreen use close paired repeats after the first orbit comparison indicated a regression.
caveats: Initial hidden-preview samples throttled to about 1 FPS and the first mixed-visibility overview were excluded; raw discarded files remain in ignored test-results/.
Timing varied across the session. Original orbit and fullscreen control runs are retained below, alongside the paired repeats used for acceptance.

The initial optimized fullscreen set had an 83.6 ms p95 outlier; all three optimized fullscreen trials were repeated against the paired control. The earlier set remains below. The final gate checks both median-of-trial p95 and worst-trial p95.
Each trial reloads a fresh seeded campaign, but existing variable dt/capping means live populations may differ. Start/end populations and scene counts are recorded.
The third paired fullscreen control was interrupted before completion and restarted from a fresh scene; only complete twenty-second samples are included.
CPU section/submission durations are not GPU execution timings. These are observed local results, not hardware-independent FPS guarantees.
